0022600033.text: The Spurs (6-2, on a six-game winning streak) visit the Sacramento Kings (1-7, on a one-game losing streak) in their 9th game of the season, with San Antonio 2-0 on the road and sitting 0.5 games behind for 2nd in the Southwest. The 2026-27 season series is tied at 1-0 for San Antonio, after the Spurs beat Sacramento 130-103 in San Antonio on October 27, and the Spurs also won their 2025-26 season series 3-0. Spurs forward Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf, strain) are out, while the Kings are without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), De'Andre Hunter (illness), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee).
